title: Named volume after container removal
statement: You start a database with `docker run -d --name db -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16`, write some data, then run `docker rm -f db`. What happens to the volume pgdata?
choices: It is deleted together with the container
It is kept only because the container was force-removed instead of stopped first
It is kept, and a new container started with -v pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data sees the same data
Its data is committed into the postgres:16 image
